title: Greek-style Orzo with Baked Feta
description: Orzo pasta baked with onion, garlic, pepper, cherry tomatoes, lemon and oregano, topped with feta and sunflower seeds until golden.
ingredients: finely grated zest and juice of 1 unwaxed lemon
small handful of mint leaves, finely chopped
90g feta cheese, cut into small chunks
steps: Place onion, garlic, pepper and tomatoes in a deep baking tray. Stir in lemon zest and juice and oregano. Spray with cooking spray; bake 15 minutes.
Remove; stir through orzo, mint and spinach; season; pour in stock; stir; bake 15 minutes.
Remove; stir orzo; top evenly with feta; sprinkle over sunflower seeds.
Bake 10 more minutes until orzo is cooked, feta melted and sunflower seeds golden.
notes: Roasted peppers from a jar can replace fresh peppers — add after orzo has cooked, before topping with feta.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
